dependencyLicenses.baseImage: Debian packages under their own licenses

brc100Http.bind: configurable; published to 127.0.0.1 in the documented run

configuration.storage: remote BRC-100 StorageServer only; no local fallback
configuration.initialization: setup page: create (24-word phrase) or restore (24 words or 64-hex seed); seed encrypted at rest (scrypt, AES-256-GCM), unlocked by password; WALLET_SEED skips setup

permissionModel.connect: exact origin allowlist (App Access); unlisted origins receive no CORS grant and are logged as blocked
permissionModel.spend: BRC-73 monthly spending authorizations per site
permissionModel.coinProtocolSigning: refused unless the origin is on WALLET_SUBSTRATE_ORIGINS (empty by default)

knownLimitations: PeerPay receive covers the main identity only; Vela does not advertise a MessageBox host
No PeerPay send from the dashboard
App Access list and per-app identity choices are local to the /data volume
Recovery phrase restores in Vela; root key is HMAC-SHA256(seed, "IDENTITY_KEY_V1")

admission.reason: Vendor-submitted candidate. The publisher suggests technical intake start from 0.2.0 rather than 0.1.0.

peerpayReceive.hostsChecked: advertised host for the identity key, VELA_MESSAGEBOX_HOSTS, and https://messagebox.babbage.systems, https://messagebox.bsvblockchain.tech, https://messagebox.1sat.app, https://message-box-us-1.bsvb.tech
peerpayReceive.accept: re-fetch message; keep a copy in /data; derive the BRC-29 key from prefix, suffix and sender; refuse unless an output pays it; internalizeAction; then acknowledge
